title: Game over reaches open tabs
description: When the game ends the server pushes a game_over message. The web client used to ignore it, so every open tab stayed on the last phase banner until it was reloaded (found by the endgame smoke preset: all four tabs stale). The status bar now switches to the game-over banner on the push. Synthetic mocked game, not a captured engine state.

shots.heading: Before: the game is in the status phase
shots.caption: Round 5, status phase. The banner names the phase.

shots.heading: After the push: the viewer won
shots.caption: The same tab, with no reload, after game_over with the viewer as winner.

shots.heading: After the push: an opponent won
shots.caption: The winner is named by the seat's display name.

shots.heading: After the push: no winner
shots.caption: A game_over without a winner reads as a draw.

notes: Checked end to end by the smoke playthrough: TI4_SMOKE_PRESET=endgame now ends with game over and the harness asserts every tab's banner says so.
